title: router_led token change is unreachable on the default sprite render path — 'node accents up' never ships
detail: Sprite path returns before any router_led read; committed puck_1/2/3.png still bake 91/238/666 px of old {46,139,87}, 0 px of {0,205,90}. Re-blessed juice golden: 50 px old green, 0 px new. Token renders only when sprite loading fails.
recommended_fix: Regenerate puck sprites via tools/gen_sprites.py with the new LED green, re-bless affected goldens, and update palcheck's LED_GREEN pin in the same change (it currently masks the no-op).

title: CVD modes override the vivid pipe/lane tokens with the pre-change muted mode tables — the pop is Off-mode-only
detail: Under deutan/protan/tritan the mode tables replace Pipe_Copper/Steel/Fiber and Lane_Standard/Lane_Best_Effort with values derived from the old muted base (deutan pipe_steel [122,132,146] is the exact old base); derive_a11y_palettes.py was not re-run, so CVD players see the gray-blue network.
recommended_fix: Re-run tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py against the vivid base (palcheck re-verifies separation) and re-bless the a11y_deutan/protan/tritan goldens, or pin the CVD-mode exclusion as an explicit accepted decision.

title: Express lane stripe collapses onto the new warm tier bands at default zoom (0.72/0.28 blend)
detail: Blend yields express-on-copper stripe (235,117,12) vs band (240,110,0) — max channel delta 12 (was ~32 pre-change); express-on-gold (246,193,12) vs (255,215,0) — ~27 (was ~47). Golden confirms (246,193,12) at 1540 px. WFQ allocation readout unpinned; no lane-vs-tier separation check exists.
recommended_fix: Add a lane-stripe-vs-tier-band separation assertion (blended default-zoom values, normal vision and CVD) or adjust the blend ratio/express hue so the priority stripe separates from copper/gold.

title: packet_dark has no reader anywhere; packet_dot is only the unknown-class fallback — both token changes are dead on the normal path
evidence:
p.packet_dot = jcol(obj, "packet_dot", {0, 130, 255, 255})
p.packet_dark = jcol(obj, "packet_dark", {0, 60, 150, 255})
[view.odin:1044-1047, the only packet_dot read]
		body := v.palette.packet_dot
		if int(p.class) < len(v.catalogs.packet_types) {
			pt := v.catalogs.packet_types[p.class]
detail: grep over app/ and harness/ finds zero reads of packet_dark; packets render catalog color_rgba via mode_class_color, so packet_dot renders only when class index is invalid. Both changed values never reach a normal frame.
recommended_fix: Remove packet_dark or give it a consumer; document packet_dot as the invalid-class fallback only so future palette edits don't assume packet rendering changes.
